[MATH: \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{3} \times {\color{green}\fbox{1}} {\color{green}\checkmark} {\color{green}\fbox{1}} \times \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2} = \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{3} \times \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2}]

\underset{\bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2} \times \bbox[lightgray, 2pt]{2}}{C}]
